page.overview:
Who is False Zelda?

In the Subspace Emissary mode, Princess Peach and Princess Zelda are captured by Petey Piranha, but one them is saved by Kirby. However, both of them are transformed into Trophies by Bowser afterward, and Shadow Bugs created dark, hostle versions of the characters.

If Zelda got turned into a trophy by Bowser, Link and Yoshi eventually arrive to the Lake Shore and are continuing in their pursuit of the Halberd. Just as the False Zelda is about to fire the Dark Cannon at the pair, Pit slashes the weapon in two, and he and Mario easily defeat the evil clone. However, just then, Link stops running and looks up to see Mario and Pit standing next to the trophy of the False Zelda, which begins to disintegrate. Thinking that Mario has destroyed the true Princess Zelda's trophy (therefore killing her) and utterly betraying their alliance/friendship, Link furiously rushes towards him and attacks Mario with a swift Down Thrust, which the plumber dodges. Link and Yoshi then engage in combat against Mario and Pit, but they lose the battle and are turned into trophies themselves.

Later Snake, Lucario, and Meta Knight encounter the two princesses (still transformed into trophies), and fight with two evil clones of them, one of the two being the false Princess Zelda. When the clones are defeated, Zelda and her Mario counterpart return to normal and assist the heroes for the remainder of the story.

If Peach is turned into a trophy instead, the same cutscene will apply but Link and Yoshi will fight the imposter and Mario/Pit in defense.
